notes.title: Update 2022-10-02
notes.content:
New Mode available!

Team Battle Conquest

Big map and two teams fighting for Capture Points.
This mode is very special because the best experience is on big screen TVs
or Projectors with friends as couch game 2v2, 3v3 or 4v4. 
This mode is working only offline.

Also a few bug fixes!
